data.one_liner: Utilities for working with Foreign Function Interface (FFI) code in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility functions and classes for working with Foreign Function Interface (FFI) code. It includes capabilities for converting between Dart strings and C strings encoded with UTF-8 and UTF-16.
use_when: You need to interoperate with C libraries from Dart
You need to handle UTF-8 and UTF-16 string conversions for C interop
avoid_when: You are writing pure Dart code without native C integration
strengths: Official utility package for Dart FFI string and memory handling
Simplifies conversion between Dart strings and C strings
weaknesses: Requires understanding of native memory management and FFI concepts
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:ffi/ffi.dart';

// Allocate and free native memory or convert strings using package utilities.
